description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (3.05 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Ice with Stacking]/[Attach Lightning with Stacking]/[Attach Water with Stacking]/[Attach Wind with Stacking] based on element of entry damage, [Damage Cap +10000], [Crystal Force Mode] and [Crystal Force Mode: Arciela] to the user

description.name: Crystal Force I
description.text: Six single attacks (2.00 each) capped at 19,999, grants [(Ice/Lightning/Water/Wind) +20% Boost 1] to the party, grants [Damage Cap +10000 1], [Instant Cast 1], [DEF and RES 50% Piercing 1] and [200% ATB 1] to the user

description.name: Crystal Force II
description.text: Six single attacks (2.00 each) capped at 19,999, grants [(Ice/Lightning/Water/Wind) +20% Boost 1] to the party, grants [Damage Cap +10000 1], [Instant Cast 1], [DEF and RES 50% Piercing 1] and [200% ATB 1] to the user

description.name: Crystal Force Mode: Arciela
description.text: Ice/Lightning/Water/Wind abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Ice, Lightning, Water and Wind abilities trigger 1 additional time, [DEF and RES 25% Piercing (15s)], removed if user hasn't Crystal Force Mode

description.name: DEF and RES 25% Piercing (15s)
description.text: Ignores 25% of the target's DEF and RES

description.name: Attach Ice with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Ice Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Ice 3

description.name: Attach Lightning with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Lightning Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Lightning 3

description.name: Attach Water with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Water Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Water 3

description.name: Attach Wind with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Wind Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Wind 3

description.name: Crystal Force Mode
description.text: Grants Crystal Force Mode, Replaces Attack and Defend commands with Crystal Force I & II, unlocks II after three actions
